Threat scenario: An attacker impersonates a legitimate test user
Mitigation: Use strong authentication and secure session handling

Threat scenario: An unauthorized user changes stored application data
Mitigation: Server-side validation and least-privilege database permissions
Validation evidence: Record configuration review or safe test result

Threat scenario: A user denies performing a sensitive action
Mitigation: Timestamped audit logs with protected access

Threat scenario: An application response exposes confidential data
column11: Review responses using dummy data only

Threat scenario: Excessive requests make the lab service unavailable
Mitigation: Rate limits and resource controls; do not perform DoS testing
Validation evidence: Review configuration only; no load test

Threat scenario: A normal user gains an administrator-only capability
Mitigation: Server-side role checks and least privilege
Validation evidence: Review roles and approved access-control tests
